{{Top|canon=Holo-Arcade}}
'''Holo-arcades''' were entertainment venues where [[Arcade game/Legends|arcade games]] could be played. [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]] on [[Stend VI]] had a holo-arcade equipped with the latest games, most of which were dedicated to virtual racing. The games could be linked together to allow up to three dozen players to race against each other.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
